Answer_with_writing_sample: Mobile applications face a myriad of security issues that can jeopardize user data and overall app integrity. This can happen if developers fail to implement proper encryption protocols, leaving user data vulnerable to interception. Another significant issue is insecure APIs; if APIs are not adequately secured, they can become gateways for attackers to access backend services and databases.
